data.summary: The pod startup was dominated by a cold image pull, which accounted for 96.4 seconds of the total 98.0-second startup time. The image size was approximately 648 MB, and the pull throughput was 6.7 MB/s. Application initialisation was efficient, completing in under 2 seconds.

findings.statement: The image pull phase took 96.357 seconds, representing the vast majority of the 98.0-second total startup time.
The image size is 647,991,705 bytes (approx. 648 MB) with a pull throughput of 6,724,905 bytes per second.
Application initialisation was relatively fast, taking only 1.888 seconds.

ruled_out.reason: Application initialisation only took 1.888 seconds, which is a small fraction of the total startup time.
Scheduling duration was 0.0 seconds, indicating no delay in pod placement.
The readiness probe was satisfied immediately after the application finished its startup sequence.

recommendations.rationale: The image pull is the primary bottleneck; reducing the image size will directly decrease the cold start time.
